notes: Isolated local fixture; no hosted database was accessed.
Corpus proves indexed tenant skew and measured work; it is not a 100-million-row production clone.
Each ordinary query uses custom and generic plans twice with analyzed statistics and warm repeats. No separate stale-statistics stress is claimed.
International fixture addresses and fixture UUID constants in observed predicates are replaced with placeholders. Exact source SQL and its hash are unchanged.
A query returning zero rows verifies syntax/index selection only; behavior tests are separate.
Full account metadata hydration and periodic backlog aggregates intentionally scan their indexed account/control scope.
Head and acquisition draft queries additionally include normal, mixed-provider, recovery-empty and recovery-eligible scenarios.
Plan nodes include scans and work-boundary nodes (sort/limit/aggregate); no child plans or query parameters are omitted from the source SQL.
Latest merge adds mailbox_unavailable admission to both draft phases and provider-scoped claims; custom/generic plans refreshed after the separate column-statistics migration.

SELECT macro_id,
            ($2::text = macro_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM macro_user_links u WHERE u.link_id = email_links.id AND u.primary_macro_id = $2)) AS authorized
        FROM email_links WHERE id = $1 AND provider IN ('OUTLOOK','IMAP') FOR SHARE

INSERT INTO email_mailbox_drafts (message_id,link_id,generation,actor_id,desired_content,base_version,provider_id)
        SELECT m.id,m.link_id,l.sync_generation,$3,
            jsonb_build_object('db_id',m.id,'provider_id',m.provider_id,'replying_to_id',m.replying_to_id,
                'provider_thread_id',m.provider_thread_id,'thread_db_id',m.thread_id,'subject',COALESCE(m.subject,''),
                'body_text',m.body_text,'body_html',m.body_html_sanitized,'body_macro',m.body_macro,'headers_json',m.headers_jsonb,
                'actor_id',$3::text,'send_time',(SELECT send_time FROM email_scheduled_messages WHERE message_id = m.id),
                'to',COALESCE(recipients.to_addresses,'[]'::jsonb),'cc',COALESCE(recipients.cc_addresses,'[]'::jsonb),'bcc',COALESCE(recipients.bcc_addresses,'[]'::jsonb),
                '_attachments',jsonb_build_object(
                    'uploads',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.id) FROM email_attachments_drafts a WHERE a.draft_id = m.id AND NOT a.upload_pending),'[]'::jsonb),
                    'forwarded',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'filename',a.filename,'mime_type',a.mime_type,'content_id',a.content_id,
                        'provider_attachment_id',a.provider_attachment_id,'provider_id',source.provider_id,'link_id',source.link_id,'thread_id',source.thread_id,'grant_generation',sl.grant_generation) ORDER BY a.id)
                        FROM email_attachments_fwd f JOIN email_attachments a ON a.id = f.attachment_id JOIN email_messages source ON source.id = a.message_id JOIN email_links sl ON sl.id = source.link_id
                        WHERE f.message_id = m.id),'[]'::jsonb),
                    'removals',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN r.provider_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('kind','provider_id','value',r.provider_id) ELSE jsonb_build_object('kind','content_id','value',r.content_id) END ORDER BY r.id)
                        FROM email_draft_attachment_removals r WHERE r.message_id = m.id),'[]'::jsonb))),
            COALESCE((SELECT versions[cardinality(versions)] FROM email_draft_organization_versions v
                WHERE v.message_id=m.id AND m.provider_version=ANY(v.versions)),m.provider_version),m.provider_id
        FROM email_messages m JOIN email_links l ON l.id = m.link_id
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('email',c.email_address,'name',COALESCE(r.name,c.name))) FILTER (WHERE r.recipient_type = 'TO') AS to_addresses,
                jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('email',c.email_address,'name',COALESCE(r.name,c.name))) FILTER (WHERE r.recipient_type = 'CC') AS cc_addresses,
                jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('email',c.email_address,'name',COALESCE(r.name,c.name))) FILTER (WHERE r.recipient_type = 'BCC') AS bcc_addresses
            FROM email_message_recipients r JOIN email_contacts c ON c.id = r.contact_id WHERE r.message_id = m.id
        ) recipients
        WHERE m.id = $1 AND m.link_id = $2 AND l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK','IMAP')
        ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET
            revision = email_mailbox_drafts.revision + 1,desired_content = EXCLUDED.desired_content,actor_id = EXCLUDED.actor_id,
            checkpoint = CASE WHEN email_mailbox_drafts.state = 'synced' OR (email_mailbox_drafts.state='failed' AND email_mailbox_drafts.error_code='invalid_content') THEN NULL ELSE email_mailbox_drafts.checkpoint END,
            error_code = CASE WHEN email_mailbox_drafts.state='failed' AND email_mailbox_drafts.error_code='invalid_content' THEN NULL ELSE email_mailbox_drafts.error_code END,
            state = CASE WHEN email_mailbox_drafts.state IN ('synced','failed','cancelled') THEN 'pending' ELSE email_mailbox_drafts.state END,
            available_at = now(),updated_at = now()

SELECT m.updated_at,m.provider_id,m.thread_id,
        CASE WHEN l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK','IMAP') THEN COALESCE(d.checkpoint->'draft'->>'version',m.provider_version,d.base_version) ELSE m.provider_history_id END AS version,
        m.is_draft,m.is_sent,
        (COALESCE(d.delete_requested,false) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_draft_transfers t WHERE t.source_id=m.id AND t.state<>'preparing')) AS "retired!",
        (m.draft_generation <> $3 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_send_attempts a WHERE a.message_id=m.id AND NOT a.cancelled AND NOT a.sent)
            OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_scheduled_messages s WHERE s.message_id=m.id)
            OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_attachments_drafts a WHERE a.draft_id=m.id AND a.upload_pending)
            OR COALESCE(d.lease_until>now(),false) OR COALESCE(d.state IN ('conflict','unknown'),false)
            OR COALESCE(d.checkpoint->>'stage' NOT IN ('inspect','ready'),false)) AS "busy!",
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_draft_transfers t WHERE t.destination_id=m.id AND t.state NOT IN ('ready','retained')) AS "predecessor!",
        jsonb_build_object('db_id',m.id,'thread_db_id',m.thread_id,'subject',COALESCE(m.subject,''),'replying_to_id',m.replying_to_id,
            'body_text',m.body_text,'body_html',m.body_html_sanitized,'body_macro',m.body_macro,'headers_json',m.headers_jsonb,
            'to',COALESCE(recipients.to_addresses,'[]'::jsonb),'cc',COALESCE(recipients.cc_addresses,'[]'::jsonb),'bcc',COALESCE(recipients.bcc_addresses,'[]'::jsonb)) AS "content!"
        FROM email_messages m JOIN email_links l ON l.id=m.link_id LEFT JOIN email_mailbox_drafts d ON d.message_id=m.id
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('email',c.email_address,'name',COALESCE(r.name,c.name))) FILTER(WHERE r.recipient_type='TO') AS to_addresses,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('email',c.email_address,'name',COALESCE(r.name,c.name))) FILTER(WHERE r.recipient_type='CC') AS cc_addresses,
            jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('email',c.email_address,'name',COALESCE(r.name,c.name))) FILTER(WHERE r.recipient_type='BCC') AS bcc_addresses
            FROM email_message_recipients r JOIN email_contacts c ON c.id=r.contact_id WHERE r.message_id=m.id) recipients
        WHERE m.id=$1 AND m.link_id=$2

SELECT l.id as "id!", l.macro_id as "macro_id!",
               l.email_address as "email_address!",
               l.provider as "provider!: _",
               l.is_sync_active as "is_sync_active!",
               l.needs_reauth as "needs_reauth!",
               l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NOT NULL as "mailbox_unavailable!",
               l.is_primary as "is_primary!",
               l.created_at as "created_at!",
               l.updated_at as "updated_at!",
               s.signature_on_replies_forwards as "signature_on_replies_forwards?",
               s.signature,
               CASE WHEN l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK','IMAP') THEN
                   CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_sync_streams ss WHERE ss.link_id = l.id AND ss.generation = l.sync_generation AND ss.kind IN ('folder_catalog','mail_folder'))
                       THEN 'Init'::email_backfill_job_status
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_sync_streams ss WHERE ss.link_id = l.id AND ss.generation = l.sync_generation AND ss.kind IN ('folder_catalog','mail_folder') AND NOT ss.initial_complete)
                       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_message_reconciliation mr WHERE mr.link_id = l.id AND mr.generation = l.sync_generation AND mr.is_import AND mr.available_at <> 'infinity')
                       THEN 'InProgress'::email_backfill_job_status
                   ELSE 'Complete'::email_backfill_job_status END
               ELSE bj.status END as "latest_backfill_status?: _",
               c.sfs_photo_url as "photo_url?",
               COALESCE(g.granted_scopes, '{}') AS "google_granted_scopes!",
               (g.calendar_disabled_at IS NOT NULL) AS "calendar_disabled!",
               EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM calendar_accounts ca WHERE ca.email_link_id = l.id
               ) AS "has_calendar_data!"
        FROM (
            SELECT el.id, el.macro_id, el.email_address, el.provider,
                   el.is_sync_active, el.needs_reauth, el.is_primary,
                   el.created_at, el.updated_at, el.sync_generation, el.mailbox_unavailable_at
            FROM email_links el
            WHERE el.macro_id = $1
            UNION
            SELECT el.id, el.macro_id, el.email_address, el.provider,
                   el.is_sync_active, el.needs_reauth, el.is_primary,
                   el.created_at, el.updated_at, el.sync_generation, el.mailbox_unavailable_at
            FROM email_links el
            JOIN macro_user_links mul ON el.id = mul.link_id
            WHERE mul.primary_macro_id = $1
        ) l
        LEFT JOIN email_link_google_scopes g ON g.link_id = l.id
        LEFT JOIN email_settings s ON s.link_id = l.id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT status FROM email_backfill_jobs
            WHERE link_id = l.id
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) bj ON true
        LEFT JOIN email_contacts c
            ON c.link_id = l.id AND LOWER(c.email_address) = LOWER(l.email_address)
        ORDER BY l.created_at DESC

SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'

WITH candidate AS (
                SELECT s.id, s.notified_traceparent FROM email_sync_streams s JOIN email_links l ON l.id = s.link_id
                WHERE l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL AND l.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
                    AND s.kind = $2 AND s.next_run_at <= now()
                    AND (s.lease_until IS NULL OR s.lease_until < now())
                ORDER BY s.next_run_at, s.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
            )
            -- The trace context is handed over once: retries get traces of
            -- their own, so a long deferral can't grow the webhook's trace.
            UPDATE email_sync_streams s SET lease_id = $1, lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes', lease_started_at = clock_timestamp(), fence = fence + 1,
                notified_traceparent = NULL
            FROM candidate c, email_links l WHERE s.id = c.id AND l.id = s.link_id
            RETURNING s.id, s.link_id, s.generation, l.grant_generation, s.scope_id,
                s.position, s.initial_complete, s.fence, s.notified_at, c.notified_traceparent,
                s.import_started_at

WITH candidate AS (
                SELECT q.link_id,q.generation,q.provider_id,q.notified_traceparent FROM email_message_reconciliation q
                JOIN email_links l ON l.id = q.link_id
                WHERE q.generation = l.sync_generation AND l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL AND l.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum
                    AND q.is_import IN (false,$2)
                    AND q.available_at <= now() AND (q.lease_until IS NULL OR q.lease_until < now())
                ORDER BY q.is_import,q.available_at,q.link_id,q.provider_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED
            )
            -- Only the first attempt joins the notification's trace. Every
            -- recorded outcome deletes the row or clears its lease, so a lease
            -- still set here expired under a worker that stopped; a revision
            -- newer than the last claim read starts the count over.
            UPDATE email_message_reconciliation q SET lease_id = $1, lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes', attempts = attempts + 1,
                unfinished_claims = CASE WHEN q.lease_id IS NULL OR q.revision <> q.claimed_revision THEN 0
                    ELSE q.unfinished_claims + 1 END,
                claimed_revision = q.revision,
                notified_traceparent = NULL
            FROM candidate c,email_links l
            WHERE q.link_id = c.link_id AND q.generation = c.generation AND q.provider_id = c.provider_id AND l.id = q.link_id
            RETURNING q.link_id,q.generation,l.grant_generation,q.provider_id,q.revision,q.is_import,q.attempts,q.unfinished_claims,q.notified_at,c.notified_traceparent

INSERT INTO email_mailbox_folders (link_id,provider_id,parent_id,display_name,role,catalog_generation,total_item_count,sync_enabled)

                ON CONFLICT (link_id,provider_id) DO UPDATE SET parent_id = EXCLUDED.parent_id,
                    display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,role = EXCLUDED.role,catalog_generation = EXCLUDED.catalog_generation,deleted_at = NULL,

DELETE FROM email_sync_streams s USING email_mailbox_folders f
            WHERE s.link_id = $1 AND s.generation = $2 AND s.kind IN ('mail_folder','mail_folder_live')
                AND f.link_id = s.link_id AND f.provider_id = s.scope_id AND (f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR NOT f.sync_enabled)

WITH candidate AS (
                SELECT c.id FROM email_mailbox_commands c JOIN email_links l ON l.id = c.link_id
                WHERE l.is_sync_active AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL AND l.provider = $2::text::email_user_provider_enum AND c.generation = l.sync_generation
                    AND c.status IN ('pending','running') AND c.available_at <= now()
                    AND (c.lease_until IS NULL OR c.lease_until < now())
                    AND c.intent->>'kind' IN ('read','flagged','archived','trashed','junk','category')
                    AND (c.intent->>'kind'<>'category' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_settings_work s
                        WHERE s.link_id=c.link_id AND s.kind='create_label' AND s.resource_key=c.intent->'value'->>'name'
                        AND s.completed_revision<s.revision))
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_command_targets target JOIN email_mailbox_drafts draft ON draft.message_id=target.message_id
                        WHERE target.command_id=c.id AND draft.lease_until>now() AND draft.lease_id IS NOT NULL OFFSET 0)
                    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_commands prior
                        WHERE prior.link_id = c.link_id AND prior.generation = c.generation
                            AND prior.status IN ('pending','running','confirming')
                            AND prior.accepted_order < c.accepted_order
                            AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_command_targets earlier JOIN email_mailbox_command_targets current
                                ON current.message_id=earlier.message_id WHERE earlier.command_id=prior.id AND current.command_id=c.id))
                ORDER BY c.available_at,c.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF c SKIP LOCKED
            )
            UPDATE email_mailbox_commands c SET lease_id = $1,lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes',
                status = 'running',attempts = attempts + 1,updated_at = now()
            FROM candidate q,email_links l WHERE c.id = q.id AND l.id = c.link_id
            RETURNING c.id,c.link_id,c.generation,l.grant_generation,c.intent,c.attempts

SELECT head.message_id AS "message_id!" FROM email_links l
                CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                    SELECT scoped.message_id,scoped.available_at FROM (
                        (SELECT d.message_id,d.available_at FROM email_mailbox_drafts d
                        WHERE $1 AND d.link_id=l.id AND d.generation=l.sync_generation
                            AND d.state IN ('pending','running','synced')
                            AND NOT(d.message_id=ANY($3))
                            AND (d.state IN ('pending','running') OR (d.state='synced' AND EXISTS(
                                SELECT 1 FROM email_scheduled_messages schedule WHERE schedule.message_id=d.message_id
                                    AND schedule.link_id=d.link_id AND NOT schedule.sent AND NOT schedule.processing AND schedule.send_time<=now())))
                            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_command_targets target JOIN email_mailbox_commands command ON command.id=target.command_id
                                WHERE target.message_id=d.message_id AND command.lease_id IS NOT NULL AND command.lease_until>now() OFFSET 0)
                            AND d.available_at<=now() AND (d.lease_until IS NULL OR d.lease_until<now())
                        ORDER BY d.available_at,d.message_id LIMIT 1)
                        UNION ALL
                        (SELECT d.message_id,d.available_at FROM email_mailbox_drafts d
                        WHERE NOT $1 AND d.checkpoint->>'stage' IN ('creating','submitting','confirming') AND d.link_id=l.id AND d.generation=l.sync_generation
                            AND d.state IN ('pending','running','synced')
                            AND NOT(d.message_id=ANY($3))
                            AND (d.state IN ('pending','running') OR (d.state='synced' AND EXISTS(
                                SELECT 1 FROM email_scheduled_messages schedule WHERE schedule.message_id=d.message_id
                                    AND schedule.link_id=d.link_id AND NOT schedule.sent AND NOT schedule.processing AND schedule.send_time<=now())))
                            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_command_targets target JOIN email_mailbox_commands command ON command.id=target.command_id
                                WHERE target.message_id=d.message_id AND command.lease_id IS NOT NULL AND command.lease_until>now() OFFSET 0)
                            AND d.available_at<=now() AND (d.lease_until IS NULL OR d.lease_until<now())
                        ORDER BY d.available_at,d.message_id LIMIT 1)
                    ) scoped ORDER BY scoped.available_at,scoped.message_id LIMIT 1
                ) head
                WHERE l.is_sync_active AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL AND l.provider=$2::text::email_user_provider_enum
                ORDER BY head.available_at,head.message_id LIMIT 1

WITH candidate AS (
                SELECT d.message_id FROM email_mailbox_drafts d
                WHERE d.message_id=$4 AND d.state IN ('pending','running','synced')
                    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l WHERE l.id=d.link_id AND l.is_sync_active AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL
                        AND l.provider=$3::text::email_user_provider_enum AND l.sync_generation=d.generation OFFSET 0)
                    AND (d.state IN ('pending','running') OR (d.state = 'synced' AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM email_scheduled_messages s WHERE s.message_id = d.message_id AND s.link_id = d.link_id
                            AND NOT s.sent AND NOT s.processing AND s.send_time <= now())))
                    AND ($2 OR d.checkpoint->>'stage' IN ('creating','submitting','confirming'))
                    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_command_targets target JOIN email_mailbox_commands command ON command.id=target.command_id
                        WHERE target.message_id=d.message_id AND command.lease_id IS NOT NULL AND command.lease_until>now() OFFSET 0)

            UPDATE email_mailbox_drafts d SET claimed_content = d.desired_content,state = 'running', lease_id = $1,lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes',updated_at = now()

            RETURNING d.message_id,d.link_id,d.generation,l.grant_generation,d.revision,d.actor_id,d.desired_content,

                    WHERE c.link_id=l.id AND c.generation=l.sync_generation AND t.message_id=$5 AND c.intent=$4 AND c.status IN ('pending','running','confirming')) RETURNING id

                    ON CONFLICT(message_id,attribute) DO UPDATE SET command_id=EXCLUDED.command_id,desired=EXCLUDED.desired

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l JOIN email_mailbox_settings_work w ON w.link_id=l.id WHERE l.id=$1 AND l.provider='IMAP' AND l.is_sync_active AND l.sync_generation=$2 AND l.grant_generation=$3 AND w.kind='sender_block' AND lower(w.resource_key)=lower($4) AND w.desired) AS "blocked!"

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l WHERE l.id=$1 AND NOT l.is_sync_active
            AND l.disconnect_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_lifecycle_outbox o
                WHERE o.link_id=l.id AND o.payload->>'kind' IN ('cleanup_microsoft_watches','revoke_microsoft_grant','disconnect_imap'))) AS "ready!"

WITH candidate AS (SELECT o.id FROM email_mailbox_lifecycle_outbox o WHERE o.available_at <= now()
            AND (o.payload->>'kind' = 'gmail_history') IN (false,true)
            AND (o.lease_until IS NULL OR o.lease_until < now())
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_lifecycle_outbox prerequisite WHERE prerequisite.link_id=o.link_id
                AND ((o.payload->>'kind'='revoke_microsoft_grant' AND prerequisite.payload->>'kind'='cleanup_microsoft_watches')
                    OR (o.payload->>'kind'='delete_mailbox' AND prerequisite.payload->>'kind' IN ('cleanup_microsoft_watches','revoke_microsoft_grant','disconnect_imap'))))
            ORDER BY (o.payload->>'kind' = 'gmail_history'),o.available_at,o.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED)
            UPDATE email_mailbox_lifecycle_outbox o SET lease_id = $1,lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes',attempts = attempts + 1
            FROM candidate c WHERE o.id = c.id RETURNING o.id,o.link_id,o.payload

SELECT l.id AS "link_id!",
                l.sync_generation AS "sync_generation!",
                l.is_sync_active AS "sync_active!",
                l.needs_reauth AS "needs_reauth!",
                l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NOT NULL AS "mailbox_unavailable!",
                q.queued AS "queued!",
                q.parked AS "parked!",
                q.abandoned AS "abandoned!",
                q.leased AS "leased!",
                COALESCE(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - q.oldest_due)), 0)::bigint AS "oldest_waiting_seconds!",
                COALESCE(ceil(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM q.parked_until - now())), 0)::bigint AS "parked_until_max_seconds!",
                s.incomplete AS "streams_incomplete!",
                COALESCE(recent.imported_5m, 0)::bigint AS "imported_5m!",
                floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - latest.last_imported_at))::bigint AS seconds_since_last_import,
                COALESCE(w.failures, 0) AS "watch_failures!"
            FROM email_links l
            LEFT JOIN email_mailbox_watch_work w ON w.link_id = l.id
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                -- Abandoned rows wait at `available_at = 'infinity'`.
                SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_at <> 'infinity') AS queued,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_at > now() AND available_at <> 'infinity') AS parked,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_at = 'infinity') AS abandoned,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE lease_until > now()) AS leased,
                    min(available_at) FILTER (
                        WHERE available_at <= now() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= now())
                    ) AS oldest_due,
                    max(available_at) FILTER (WHERE available_at > now() AND available_at <> 'infinity') AS parked_until
                FROM email_message_reconciliation
                WHERE link_id = l.id AND generation = l.sync_generation
            ) q
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT count(*) AS incomplete
                FROM email_sync_streams
                WHERE link_id = l.id AND generation = l.sync_generation
                    AND kind IN ('folder_catalog', 'mail_folder') AND NOT initial_complete
            ) s
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT sum(imported) AS imported_5m
                FROM email_mailbox_import_minutes
                WHERE link_id = l.id AND minute > now() - interval '5 minutes'
            ) recent
            -- A flush carries imports from at most the minute before it, so
            -- the latest import is in one of the two newest minutes.
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT max(last_imported_at) AS last_imported_at
                FROM (
                    SELECT last_imported_at FROM email_mailbox_import_minutes
                    WHERE link_id = l.id ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 2
                ) newest
            ) latest
            WHERE l.provider = $1::text::email_user_provider_enum AND (l.is_sync_active OR q.queued > 0 OR q.abandoned > 0)

WITH candidate AS (
                SELECT due.id FROM email_links l
                CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                    SELECT o.id,o.available_at FROM email_projection_outbox o
                    WHERE o.link_id=l.id AND o.available_at<=now()
                        AND (o.lease_until IS NULL OR o.lease_until<now())
                    ORDER BY o.available_at,o.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED
                ) due
                WHERE l.is_sync_active AND l.provider=$2::text::email_user_provider_enum
                ORDER BY due.available_at,due.id LIMIT 1
            )
            -- Every recorded outcome deletes the entry or clears its lease, so a
            -- lease still set here expired under a worker that stopped.
            UPDATE email_projection_outbox o SET lease_id = $1,lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes',attempts = attempts + 1,
                unfinished_claims = CASE WHEN o.lease_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE o.unfinished_claims + 1 END
            FROM candidate c,email_links l WHERE o.id = c.id AND l.id = o.link_id
            RETURNING o.id,o.link_id,o.generation,o.payload,o.attempts,o.unfinished_claims,l.sync_generation,l.grant_generation
SELECT id FROM email_links WHERE provider = $1::text::email_user_provider_enum ORDER BY created_at, id

SELECT l.provider = $3::text::email_user_provider_enum AS "outlook!", l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth AS "active!",
                l.sync_generation, l.grant_generation,
                EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_sync_streams s WHERE s.link_id = l.id AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
                        AND s.kind IN ('folder_catalog','mail_folder') AND NOT s.initial_complete)
                    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_message_reconciliation q WHERE q.link_id = l.id AND q.generation = l.sync_generation
                        AND q.is_import AND q.available_at <> 'infinity') AS "importing!",
                due.inbox_and_sent AS "inbox_and_sent!", due.other_folders AS "other_folders!",
                (SELECT sum(f.total_item_count) FROM email_mailbox_folders f WHERE f.link_id = l.id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL)::bigint AS provider_items
            FROM email_links l
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.role IN ('inbox','sent')) AS inbox_and_sent,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.role NOT IN ('inbox','sent')) AS other_folders
                FROM email_sync_streams s JOIN email_mailbox_folders f ON f.link_id = s.link_id AND f.provider_id = s.scope_id
                WHERE s.link_id = l.id AND s.generation = l.sync_generation AND s.kind = 'mail_folder' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                    AND (s.reader_revision IS NULL OR s.reader_revision < $2)
            ) due
            WHERE l.id = $1

SELECT id FROM email_links WHERE id = $1 AND provider = $4::text::email_user_provider_enum AND sync_generation = $2
                AND grant_generation = $3 AND is_sync_active AND NOT needs_reauth FOR UPDATE

WITH candidate AS (
            SELECT s.id FROM email_links l JOIN email_mailbox_settings_work s ON s.link_id=l.id
            WHERE (l.provider='GMAIL' OR (s.kind='catalog' AND $2) OR (s.kind<>'catalog' AND $3))
            AND (l.provider = $4::text::email_user_provider_enum OR (l.provider='GMAIL' AND $4='OUTLOOK'))
            AND l.is_sync_active AND l.disconnect_requested_at IS NULL AND l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NULL AND s.next_run_at<=now() AND (s.kind='catalog' OR s.revision>s.completed_revision)
            AND (s.lease_until IS NULL OR s.lease_until<now())
            AND (s.kind<>'delete_label' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_commands c
                WHERE c.link_id=s.link_id AND c.generation=l.sync_generation AND c.status IN ('pending','running','confirming')
                AND c.intent->>'kind'='category' AND c.intent->'value'->>'name'=s.resource_key))
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_settings_work busy WHERE busy.link_id=l.id AND busy.lease_until>now())
            ORDER BY s.next_run_at,s.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF l,s SKIP LOCKED
        ) UPDATE email_mailbox_settings_work s SET lease_id=$1,lease_until=now()+interval '3 minutes',attempts=attempts+1
        FROM candidate c,email_links l WHERE s.id=c.id AND l.id=s.link_id
        RETURNING s.id,s.link_id,s.revision,s.kind,s.resource_key,s.desired,l.sync_generation,l.grant_generation,l.provider::text AS "provider!"

SELECT l.id as "id!", l.macro_id as "macro_id!",
               l.fusionauth_user_id as "fusionauth_user_id!",
               l.email_address as "email_address!",
               l.provider as "provider!: _",
               l.is_sync_active as "is_sync_active!",
               l.is_primary as "is_primary!",
               l.needs_reauth as "needs_reauth!",
               l.mailbox_unavailable_at IS NOT NULL as "mailbox_unavailable!",
               l.last_sync_error_at,
               l.created_at as "created_at!",
               l.updated_at as "updated_at!",
               s.signature_on_replies_forwards as "signature_on_replies_forwards?",
               s.signature,
               s.read_receipts_enabled as "read_receipts_enabled?",
               CASE WHEN l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK','IMAP') THEN
                   CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_sync_streams ss WHERE ss.link_id = l.id AND ss.generation = l.sync_generation AND ss.kind IN ('folder_catalog','mail_folder'))
                       THEN 'Init'::email_backfill_job_status
                   WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_sync_streams ss WHERE ss.link_id = l.id AND ss.generation = l.sync_generation AND ss.kind IN ('folder_catalog','mail_folder') AND NOT ss.initial_complete)
                       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_message_reconciliation mr WHERE mr.link_id = l.id AND mr.generation = l.sync_generation AND mr.is_import AND mr.available_at <> 'infinity')
                       THEN 'InProgress'::email_backfill_job_status
                   ELSE 'Complete'::email_backfill_job_status END
               ELSE bj.status END as "latest_backfill_status?: _",
               c.sfs_photo_url as "photo_url?",
               CASE WHEN l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK','IMAP') THEN COALESCE(ms.granted_scopes, '{}') ELSE COALESCE(g.granted_scopes, '{}') END AS "provider_granted_scopes!",
               (CASE WHEN l.provider IN ('OUTLOOK','IMAP') THEN ms.calendar_disabled_at ELSE g.calendar_disabled_at END IS NOT NULL) AS "calendar_disabled!",
               EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM calendar_accounts ca WHERE ca.email_link_id = l.id
               ) AS "has_calendar_data!"
        FROM (
            SELECT el.id, el.macro_id, el.fusionauth_user_id, el.email_address,
                   el.provider, el.is_sync_active, el.is_primary, el.needs_reauth,
                   el.last_sync_error_at, el.created_at, el.updated_at,el.sync_generation,el.grant_generation,
                   el.mailbox_unavailable_at
            FROM email_links el
            WHERE el.macro_id = $1
            UNION
            SELECT el.id, el.macro_id, el.fusionauth_user_id, el.email_address,
                   el.provider, el.is_sync_active, el.is_primary, el.needs_reauth,
                   el.last_sync_error_at, el.created_at, el.updated_at,el.sync_generation,el.grant_generation,
                   el.mailbox_unavailable_at
            FROM email_links el
            JOIN macro_user_links mul ON el.id = mul.link_id
            WHERE mul.primary_macro_id = $1
        ) l
        LEFT JOIN email_link_google_scopes g ON g.link_id = l.id
        LEFT JOIN email_link_microsoft_scopes ms ON ms.link_id = l.id AND ms.grant_generation = l.grant_generation
        LEFT JOIN email_settings s ON s.link_id = l.id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT status FROM email_backfill_jobs
            WHERE link_id = l.id
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) bj ON true
        LEFT JOIN email_contacts c
            ON c.link_id = l.id AND LOWER(c.email_address) = LOWER(l.email_address)
        ORDER BY l.created_at DESC

WITH retained AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT a.link_id,a.sync_generation,a.grant_generation,a.updated_at
                FROM imap_accounts a JOIN email_links l ON l.id=a.link_id
                WHERE a.link_id=ANY($2) AND l.macro_id=a.user_id AND l.provider='IMAP'
                    AND l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                    AND (a.state->>'needs_reauth') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
                    AND a.sync_generation=l.sync_generation AND a.grant_generation=l.grant_generation
                ORDER BY a.updated_at,a.link_id LIMIT $1
            ), candidates AS (
                SELECT a.link_id,a.sync_generation,a.grant_generation,a.updated_at
                FROM imap_accounts a JOIN email_links l ON l.id=a.link_id
                WHERE NOT(a.link_id=ANY($2)) AND l.macro_id=a.user_id AND l.provider='IMAP'
                    AND l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                    AND (a.state->>'needs_reauth') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
                    AND a.sync_generation=l.sync_generation AND a.grant_generation=l.grant_generation
                    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM imap_account_owners o WHERE o.link_id=a.link_id AND o.lease_until>now())
                ORDER BY a.updated_at,a.link_id
                LIMIT greatest($1-(SELECT count(*) FROM retained),0)
            )
            SELECT link_id AS "link_id!",sync_generation AS "sync_generation!",grant_generation AS "grant_generation!"
            FROM (SELECT retained.*,0 AS priority FROM retained UNION ALL SELECT candidates.*,1 AS priority FROM candidates) batch
            ORDER BY priority,updated_at,link_id

SELECT jsonb_set(e.document->'folder', '{role}',
                       COALESCE(NULLIF(e.document->'detected_role', 'null'::jsonb), e.document->'folder'->'role')) AS "folder!",
                      COALESCE((e.document->>'monitored')::boolean, true) AS "monitored!"
               FROM imap_state_entries e JOIN imap_accounts a ON a.link_id=e.link_id
               WHERE a.link_id=$1 AND a.sync_generation=$2 AND a.grant_generation=$3 AND e.kind='folder'
               ORDER BY e.key LIMIT $4

WITH changed AS (
             UPDATE imap_accounts SET folder_preferences_revision=folder_preferences_revision+1, revision=revision+1,
                 folder_role_overrides=$5, excluded_folder_ids=$6, watched_folder_ids=$7, updated_at=now()
             FROM email_links l WHERE imap_accounts.link_id=$1 AND imap_accounts.sync_generation=$2
               AND imap_accounts.grant_generation=$3 AND folder_preferences_revision=$4
               AND l.id=imap_accounts.link_id AND l.macro_id=imap_accounts.user_id AND l.provider='IMAP' AND l.is_sync_active
               AND l.disconnect_requested_at IS NULL AND l.deleting_at IS NULL
               AND l.sync_generation=imap_accounts.sync_generation AND l.grant_generation=imap_accounts.grant_generation
             RETURNING imap_accounts.link_id, folder_preferences_revision)
             SELECT c.folder_preferences_revision AS "revision!" FROM changed c
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_notify('imap_config_changed', c.link_id::text)

nodes.filter: (is_sync_active AND (disconnect_requested_at IS NULL) AND (deleting_at IS NULL) AND (sync_generation = '1'::bigint) AND (grant_generation = '1'::bigint) AND (provider = 'IMAP'::email_user_provider_enum))
(is_sync_active AND (disconnect_requested_at IS NULL) AND (deleting_at IS NULL) AND (sync_generation = $2) AND (grant_generation = $3) AND (provider = 'IMAP'::email_user_provider_enum))

SELECT kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND kind='folder' ORDER BY key LIMIT 2000
SELECT kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND kind='message' AND folder_id=ANY($2) ORDER BY received_at DESC,key LIMIT $3
SELECT kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND kind='location' AND message_id=ANY($2)
SELECT kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND kind='upload' AND key=$2

SELECT DISTINCT ON(message_id) kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND kind='location' AND folder_id=$2 AND message_id>$3 ORDER BY message_id,key LIMIT 501

SELECT kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND kind='change' AND folder_id=$2 AND (sequence>$3 OR sequence=(SELECT min(sequence) FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND kind='change' AND folder_id=$2)) ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 502

nodes.indexCond: ((link_id = '<fixture-id>'::uuid) AND (kind = 'change'::text) AND (folder_id = 'inbox'::text) AND (sequence IS NOT NULL))

nodes.indexCond: ((link_id = $1) AND (kind = 'change'::text) AND (folder_id = $2) AND (sequence IS NOT NULL))

nodes.recheck: (((link_id = $1) AND (kind = 'change'::text) AND (folder_id = $2) AND (sequence > $3)) OR ((link_id = $1) AND (kind = 'change'::text) AND (folder_id = $2) AND (sequence = $1)))

queries.sql: SELECT kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND ((kind='message' AND key=$2) OR (kind='location' AND message_id=$2))

SELECT kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND ((kind='draft' AND key=$2) OR (kind='attachment' AND message_id=$2) OR (kind='message' AND key=$2))

nodes.recheck: (((link_id = '<fixture-id>'::uuid) AND (kind = 'draft'::text)) OR ((link_id = '<fixture-id>'::uuid) AND (kind = 'attachment'::text)) OR ((link_id = '<fixture-id>'::uuid) AND (kind = 'message'::text) AND (key = 'm:000001'::text)))
(((link_id = $1) AND (kind = 'draft'::text)) OR ((link_id = $1) AND (kind = 'attachment'::text)) OR ((link_id = $1) AND (kind = 'message'::text) AND (key = $2)))

queries.sql: SET LOCAL statement_timeout='30s'
DELETE FROM imap_state_entries WHERE link_id=$1 AND kind IN('attachment','upload') AND message_id=ANY($2)
DELETE FROM imap_state_entries e USING jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS d(kind text,key text) WHERE e.link_id=$1 AND e.kind=d.kind AND e.key=d.key

INSERT INTO imap_state_entries(link_id,kind,key,folder_id,message_id,sequence,received_at,document,body) SELECT $1,d.kind,d.key,d.folder_id,d.message_id,d.sequence,d.received_at,d.document,decode(d.body,'base64') FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS d(kind text,key text,folder_id text,message_id text,sequence bigint,received_at timestamptz,document jsonb,body text) ON CONFLICT(link_id,kind,key) DO UPDATE SET folder_id=EXCLUDED.folder_id,message_id=EXCLUDED.message_id,sequence=EXCLUDED.sequence,received_at=EXCLUDED.received_at,document=EXCLUDED.document,body=EXCLUDED.body

UPDATE imap_accounts SET state=$6,revision=revision+1,lease_until=now()+interval '5 minutes',updated_at=now() WHERE link_id=$1 AND sync_generation=$2 AND grant_generation=$3 AND lease_id=$4 AND revision=$5 AND lease_until>now() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l WHERE l.id=imap_accounts.link_id AND l.macro_id=imap_accounts.user_id AND l.provider='IMAP' AND l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth AND l.sync_generation=imap_accounts.sync_generation AND l.grant_generation=imap_accounts.grant_generation) RETURNING revision
SELECT id,user_id,credential_owner,email,link_id,verification_id,sync_generation,grant_generation,expected_generation,completed FROM email_imap_connection_attempts WHERE id=$1 AND user_id=$2

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l JOIN email_imap_connection_attempts a ON a.link_id=l.id WHERE a.id=$1 AND l.macro_id=$2 AND l.is_sync_active AND l.sync_generation=a.sync_generation AND l.grant_generation=a.grant_generation) AS "current!"
SELECT 1 AS locked FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))

SELECT id,macro_id,provider::text AS provider,sync_generation,grant_generation,disconnect_requested_at,deleting_at FROM email_links WHERE lower(email_address)=lower($1) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT
            EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "RolesOnUsers" ru JOIN "RolesOnPermissions" rp ON rp."roleId"=ru."roleId" WHERE ru."userId"=$1 AND rp."permissionId"='read:professional_features') AS "professional!",
            (SELECT count(*) FROM email_links l WHERE l.macro_id=$1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM macro_user_links u WHERE u.link_id=l.id AND u.primary_macro_id=$1)) AS "inboxes!"

INSERT INTO email_links(id,macro_id,fusionauth_user_id,email_address,provider,is_sync_active,sync_generation,grant_generation)
                VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,'IMAP',false,$5,$6)
INSERT INTO email_settings(link_id) VALUES($1) ON CONFLICT(link_id) DO NOTHING
SELECT id FROM email_imap_connection_attempts WHERE link_id=$1 AND NOT completed

            VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
SELECT completed FROM email_imap_connection_attempts WHERE id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND link_id=$3 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,macro_id,provider::text AS provider,sync_generation FROM email_links WHERE lower(email_address)=lower($1) LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE email_links SET is_sync_active=true,needs_reauth=false,sync_generation=$2,grant_generation=$3,last_sync_error_at=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1
UPDATE email_mailbox_commands SET generation=$2,status='pending',lease_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE link_id=$1 AND generation=$3 AND status IN ('pending','running','confirming')
UPDATE email_mailbox_drafts SET generation=$2,lease_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE link_id=$1 AND state NOT IN ('sent','deleted')
INSERT INTO email_sync_streams(id,link_id,generation,kind,scope_id) VALUES($1,$2,$3,'folder_catalog','mail') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
UPDATE email_imap_connection_attempts SET completed=true,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1
DELETE FROM email_links WHERE id=$1 AND macro_id=$2 AND NOT is_sync_active AND sync_generation=$3 AND disconnect_requested_at IS NULL

((NOT is_sync_active) AND (disconnect_requested_at IS NULL) AND (id = $1) AND (sync_generation = $3))

SELECT id,user_id FROM email_imap_connection_attempts WHERE NOT completed ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 100

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l WHERE lower(email_address)=lower($2) AND (l.macro_id=$1 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM macro_user_links u WHERE u.link_id=l.id AND u.primary_macro_id=$1))) AS "connected!"

SELECT macro_id, provider='IMAP' AS "uses_imap!",
                      is_sync_active AND disconnect_requested_at IS NULL AND deleting_at IS NULL AS "active!",
                      sync_generation,grant_generation FROM email_links WHERE id=$1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links WHERE lower(email_address)=lower($1) AND provider<>'GMAIL') AS "conflict!"
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links WHERE lower(email_address)=lower($1) AND provider<>'OUTLOOK') AS "conflict!"

UPDATE email_attachments a SET upload_claimed_at = NULL FROM email_messages m
            WHERE a.message_id = m.id AND m.link_id = $1 AND m.id = $2
                AND a.upload_claimed_at < now() - interval '3 minutes'
                AND a.upload_abandoned_at IS NULL
                AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_email d WHERE d.email_attachment_id = a.id)
                AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_attachments_sfs s WHERE s.attachment_id = a.id)

UPDATE email_attachments SET upload_claimed_at = NULL
                WHERE id = $1 AND upload_claimed_at = $2

UPDATE email_attachments SET
                upload_failures = upload_failures + 1,
                upload_claimed_at = CASE WHEN upload_failures + 1 >= $3 THEN upload_claimed_at END,
                upload_abandoned_at = CASE WHEN upload_failures + 1 >= $3 THEN now() END
            WHERE id = $1 AND upload_claimed_at = $2
            RETURNING upload_failures, upload_abandoned_at IS NOT NULL AS "abandoned!"
SET statement_timeout = '30s'
